title: Keeping Exports in the LOOP
summary:
The impact of a VLCC export terminal in the U.S. Gulf
The announcement this week that Louisiana Offshore Oil Port (LOOP) is thinking about getting involved in the crude oil export business is a big deal. LOOP is the only port in the contiguous United States that can receive fully laden VLCCs (or even ULCCs).
